claim: Let \(M=G(8,3)\) be the Möbius–Kantor graph. Its independence complex satisfies \[\operatorname{Ind}(M)\simeq \bigvee^{4}S^{3}\vee S^{4}.\]

integrity.proof_basis: finite exhaustive face enumeration, acyclic discrete-Morse matching, exact modular boundary elimination, and a standard Hurewicz argument
integrity.unproved_limits: No claim is made for other generalized Petersen graphs or for a classification of regular bipartite graphs.

limitations: Single-graph result; no family-level generalization is claimed.
Originality is assessed only against the explicitly inspected sources and semantic searches.
title: Independence complex of the Möbius–Kantor graph is \(\bigvee^{4}S^{3}\vee S^{4}\)
